review.summary: Both requested fixes are present: Gemini model selection is restricted to the stated allowlist before provider calls, and the rate-limit bucket map is capped after pruning even when all buckets are active. No concrete high-severity issue is verifiable in the supplied diff.

checks.detail: getGeminiModel() rejects model IDs outside FREE_TIER_MODELS before either generation function calls the provider. The limiter sweeps expired buckets and evicts the oldest inserted buckets until its map is at MAX_BUCKETS.
The model value is constrained to an allowlist and safe character pattern; the limiter uses the final X-Forwarded-For entry as documented for the stated single-proxy setup.
Invalid model configuration throws GeminiError with CONFIGURATION; provider errors are classified and surfaced as GeminiError. Rate-limited requests receive a 429 response and Retry-After header.
The environment-configured model is checked against both a format pattern and the allowlist before provider use. No concrete unvalidated external input issue is established by this diff.
Both requested resolutions are implemented in the reviewed files.
The limiter preserves per-IP, per-endpoint windows and the standard error response. Gemini defaults to the stated allowed model when GEMINI_MODEL is unset.
No test changes are included in the supplied diff. The two fixes are directly verifiable in the implementation; no test-related defect is established from the provided scope.
The allowlist and bucket cap behavior are named and documented; the eviction loop is bounded by the overflow count.
